blocks.hypothesis: Product type/assortment may add signal beyond item/product counts and price.
blocks.availability_assumption: Unversioned catalogue category represents the purchased listing; unverified snapshot proxy.

blocks.hypothesis: Listed physical burden may add handling/experience information; not measured parcel packing.
blocks.availability_assumption: Unversioned catalogue dimensions/weight approximate order-time attributes; unverified.

blocks.hypothesis: Multiple origins and cross-state fulfilment may add signal beyond destination state.
blocks.availability_assumption: Recorded seller IDs/states approximate placed-order allocation; unverified.

blocks.hypothesis: Maximum seller-to-customer distance may add a static geographic proxy.
blocks.availability_assumption: Seller allocation and static ZIP/geolocation references are representative; not a road route or time-certified geography.

blocks.hypothesis: Payment arrangement may add transaction context; lower prior priority based on rich-block evidence.
blocks.availability_assumption: Final payment aggregates approximate chosen arrangement; no event timestamps prove order-placement availability.

limitations: Earlier dataset, validation and terminal evidence already examined; exploratory reused-data study.
Fixed-model block tests do not establish globally optimal individual feature subsets.
Mean/fold practical flags are not statistical significance or deployment certification.
Availability assumptions must be independently justified before adoption.
No feature/model/threshold selected from terminal or original holdout results.
